description: The plot illustrates the variation in precision, recall, and F1-score for different model variants of MS-FSLHate on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variant” and displays categorical values: “Full model,” “w/o Prompt,” “w/o Augmentation,” “w/o Attention,” and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation.” The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 57 to 66, with tick labels at intervals of 2. There are three lines displayed: a blue solid line representing precision, which starts at approximately 65.45% for the “Full model” and declines to 64.06% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; a green dashed line representing recall, which begins at approximately 65.78% for the “Full model” and decreases to 59.17% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”; and a red dotted line representing F1-score, which starts at approximately 65.56% for the “Full model” and declines to 57.74% for “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
